FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: AI Detects MA20 Support as Fundamentals Turn Bullish
tldr_points: USD/JPY holds above MA20 as AI and NFP momentum favor upside.
Non-farm payrolls beat supports near-term USD bid tone.

FX.excerpt: USD/JPY defends MA20 as NFP beat fuels USD; momentum eyes upside confirmation.

STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] UP: Oversold RSI Signals Tactical Rebound Toward MA20
tldr_points: The S&P 500 suffered its worst week since the April 2025 tariff crash, breaking below key moving averages.
RSI(14) has reached 34.73, signaling extreme oversold conditions and a high-probability tactical rebound.
A strategic long entry is advised near current levels with a target toward the 20-day moving average at 7657.80.
STOCKS.excerpt: S&P 500 drops to 7376.86 with oversold RSI at 34.73, signaling a strong tactical rebound toward MA20 resistance at 7657.80.
STOCKS.comment: Oversold RSI at 34.73 and sharp discount to MA20 signal a tactical rebound toward 7657.80.
